title: Rename the working identifier wire to the chosen feature name
description:
Chore in the `wire` epic, to run once Ryan picks the feature name (open question 1 in the epic). Until then, nothing to do.

Rename the working identifier `wire` everywhere it appears as the feature name: `projection.json` key `wire`, `_data/wire/` (with a one-release compatibility read of the old directory in `WireSource`, then remove), `src/papyrus_content/wire/`, `projection/standard/wire*.py`, `papyrus-wire.css`, the projection task `wire-snapshot`, the plugin `amplify/plugins/wire/`, `KNOWN_PLUGINS`, the schedule prefix `papyrus-wire-snapshot-`, the debounce pk, the CLI `papyrus wire ...`, `docs/wire.md`, the feature files `features_backend/wire-*.feature` and their step module names, the Anth.us `projection.json` and `papyrus.config.ts` (site PR). Keep the Anth.us segment and label "newsroom" as they are: they are the site's choice, not the feature name.

Acceptance: `git grep -i wire` in Papyrus returns only unrelated hits (e.g. "wire(backend, ...)" in the plugin API); CI green; one release; Anth.us bumped. Gherkin: no behaviour change, so the existing scenarios pass unchanged under the new names.
